title: Will SOL close above $300 on 2026-12-31?
description: Daily close of the SOL/USD pair on Coinbase, UTC.
resolutionCriteria: YES if the SOL/USD daily close on Coinbase for 2026-12-31 (00:00 UTC bar) is strictly greater than 300.00 USD. NO otherwise. If Coinbase does not publish a close, the resolver uses the CoinGecko daily close for the same date.
